idea-plugin.name: Dependency Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
Inspects Gradle dependency versions and reports when newer versions are available.
The plugin is designed as an alternative to Android Lint's dependency version checks for non-Android projects.
Currently supports Gradle Version Catalogs and provides quick-fixes for updating outdated versions.
Support for Maven POM files, Gradle Kotlin and Groovy DSL files, and additional repositories such as Google Maven and the Gradle Plugin Portal is planned.
